summary: Wired's Black Friday/Cyber Monday 2023 roundup by Brenda Stolyar lists 54 discounted Apple products and accessories, organized by iPads, MacBooks, Apple Watches, Beats and AirPods, chargers, and cases. Apple doesn't discount on its own storefront but offers up to $200 in Apple Store credit with select purchases through November 27, and Amazon sells Apple gift cards with bonus coupons. Wired's testers include ratings and notes on whether each deal is truly good, based on street prices from the past few months.
one_line: Wired's curated list of 54 Apple Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2023 deals across iPads, MacBooks, Apple Watches, AirPods, chargers, and accessories.
key_facts: Apple doesn't run sales on its own storefront but offers up to $200 in Apple Store credit with select purchases through November 27, 2023.
Buying an iPhone 14 or iPhone SE earns up to $75 in Apple Store credit; buying a MacBook Air earns up to $200.
Amazon sells Apple gift cards with coupon codes, e.g. a $100 Apple Gift Card plus a free $15 Amazon credit with code APPLET5USAP.
The ninth-generation iPad (8/10, WIRED Recommends) is Wired's best iPad for most people, with 64 GB base storage, a True Tone display, a 12-megapixel rear camera, and a Touch ID home button.
The iPad Air (8/10) has a 10.9-inch LCD, USB-C, and the same M1 processor as the 2020 MacBook Air; the iPad Mini (8/10) has an 8.3-inch display and A15 Bionic chip.
The 14-inch M3 MacBook Pro was released less than a month before and replaces the 13-inch MacBook Pro; Wired recommends it for people who want Pro features without spending almost $2,000.
The M2 MacBook Air (7/10) is noted to have dipped to $899 in the past; the 15-inch MacBook Air (8/10) is on sale for $1,449 ($250 off).
The M1 MacBook Air (9/10), released in 2020, remains Wired's favorite budget MacBook.
The Apple Watch Ultra 2 (8/10) has a 3,000-nit display and S9 chip, and has the best battery life of any Apple Watch.
The Powerbeats Pro (8/10) came out in 2019 and have IPX4 water resistance and nine hours of battery life, plus 18 extra hours in the case.
The Beats Studio Pro are $10 cheaper than on Prime Day, the lowest price Wired has tracked; the Beats Fit Pro (9/10) have dipped as low as $159.
The Zendure SuperTank Pro has a 26,800-mAh capacity and up to 100 watts in or out, and is Wired's favorite power bank for air travel.
Otterbox has 25 percent off everything on its site, and Incipio has up to 50 percent off a wide selection of cases and accessories.
iPhone deals are typically offered by carriers like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile with requirements such as unlimited plans or new lines.
